scope.sourcePinRule: Any future assignment must take its source pin from root-approved actual source bindings. No pin is inferred by this report.
scope.operationsPerformed: Read static source and exact allowed public status/results metadata only. Wrote only this fresh external report. No wire files, private state, raw database, native checkpoints, profile, runtime, capture, flags, budget change, retries, audit, or checkout edits.

recommendation.firstChoice: Skip derived candidate generation while the existing operational acquisition latch is closed. Retain every full incoming wire, public frame, latest frame and genuine UI-action literal; run the unchanged window calculation and predicate after the existing latch opens.
recommendation.scope: Capture-only prospective generation change at current calls564 and572, not an ordinary game setup or product behavior change. No implementation is supplied or applied.
recommendation.whySmallest: Before acquisitionStartTick is assigned, selectionEligible is false. These calls generate permanently unselectable early summaries. The frozen auditor requires a bounded candidates list and the selected candidate, not the historical sequence of nonselected summaries.
preservedContract: The selected candidate is generated and retained before selection; result and window selected indexes agree.
The positive predicate still requires both commanded humans and human target owners2/3, living human HQs, contiguous four-tick public frames and a window of at most400ticks.
Original wire ordinals and all complete payloads remain retained. Selected-window preceding frame, commands, acknowledgements and UI lifecycles remain available.
Native audit still authenticates one naturally committed wave containing owners2/3 and qualifying post-launch attacks.
recommendation.whyNotTruncation: Generation is skipped prospectively before those derived summaries exist. No file rows are deleted or shortened after capture; no literal exposed payload is omitted. This does not authorize editing the already failed R7 evidence.
recommendation.finalFailureHandling: The current finally block may generate one failure summary at603. It need not reconstruct skipped history. Passing captures still need at least one retained selected candidate. Any failure stays a failure and is not retried.
recommendation.budgetAccounting: save() subtracts the previous file size and adds the replacement size; savings concern the current public-windows.json size rather than cumulative rewrite I/O. The nine literal public inputs still have the unchanged64MiB bound.

whyCurrentOwner2HqWaitIsLate.currentSetup: Four players, small map, age1, orcs/fairies/orcs/orcs, shared vision; genuine attack-move and hold stage both human armies near side0 HQ.
whyCurrentOwner2HqWaitIsLate.currentTrigger: Both profiles must observe at least one living non-worker owner2 unit, on the HQ level and within12map units of side0 HQ. It neither waits for owner3 nor proves wave participation. Ground target remains6map units from the same HQ.
whyCurrentOwner2HqWaitIsLate.cost: Staging travel, hold confirmation, AI production/cooldown, and then owner2 travel to the human HQ all run while every full snapshot continues to be retained. The latch opens only after renewed genuine attack-move commands. Early qualifying-looking fights before that latch cannot be selected.
whyCurrentOwner2HqWaitIsLate.scoutCaution: Balanced profile begins scouting after65seconds. The coordinator assigns one scout and breaks owner ties by side; dispatch marks initial-scout completion for both allied reporters. A single owner2 arrival is compatible with that one-owner operation. Public appearance alone cannot establish whether the observed actor belongs to a later committed shared wave.

naturalSharedWaveRequirements.ownerRequirements: Each AI reporter must have a completed living owned HQ, recoverable income and at least two eligible fighters. Fighters exclude workers, illusions, retreating units, active directive assignments and entrenched units, and share the HQ level.
naturalSharedWaveRequirements.combinedRequirement: Two participating owners and at least four fighters combined; no cooperative starting-age or full-faction-army-size requirement.
naturalSharedWaveRequirements.targetRequirement: Both owners approve the same known target key, coordinates and level. HQ/building targets outrank units and known starts; distance is not a target sort key.
naturalSharedWaveRequirements.firstWaveTiming: Default normal/balanced/infantry-rush has waveIntervalFactor1. Initial aiWave is0. Readiness is last committed launch plus max(15,65/factionAggression). A wave can be created up to12seconds before readiness and dispatches no earlier than max(creation+3seconds,both readiness times). Owner launches apply together in one simulation step.
naturalSharedWaveRequirements.positioningConstraint: Visible humans within less than12units of either AI HQ create priority defense threats. Those threats block new shared-wave creation and can occupy up to three nearby fighters per threat.
naturalSharedWaveRequirements.auditRequirement: Retained selected wave must be launched for team1 with owners2/3, at least four distinct participant IDs, equal committed aiWave clocks, adjacent four-tick launch bracket and exact source-derived attack-move transitions. Both commanded humans must then produce positive attacks against the same authenticated participant set, collectively covering AI owners2/3, with living human HQs.

ordinaryUiAlternatives.choice: Keep current age1, small map, factions and staging; skip pre-latch derived summaries.
ordinaryUiAlternatives.assessment: Smallest overall correction supported by the existing frozen audit contract. It recovers byte capacity without changing match acquisition behavior. Timeline remains unproven here.

ordinaryUiAlternatives.choice: Change both AI faction selectors to undead; leave human factions, age1, teams/controllers and shared vision unchanged.
ordinaryUiAlternatives.assessment: Best setup-only fallback hypothesis. Both timers become65/1.1≈59.09seconds instead of65. Undead melee costs45wood/15ore, trains24seconds and moves2.35, versus orc70/25,36seconds,1.8. Undead ranged trains32seconds/speed2.25 versus orc40seconds/2.0. Both AI factions must change because dispatch waits for both readiness times.
risks: Lower undead health/armor can kill participants before both humans engage.
Different recruitment composition, retreat behavior and special-unit systems can change timing and evidence size.
The current producer faction assertion at532 must agree with the ordinary selected lobby factions in any separately reviewed future producer.
Source rates do not prove completion within64MiB.

ordinaryUiAlternatives.choice: Stage both human forces on public observed open ground closer to the AI approach route, comfortably beyond12units from both AI HQs.
ordinaryUiAlternatives.assessment: Can reduce travel-to-contact while preserving the natural cooldown. Use stationary visible terrain/actors and genuine UI move, hold and attack-move commands. A visible human unit may become a shared target if no higher-ranked known building exists.
risks: A human force too near an AI HQ causes defense instead of a new shared wave.
Hold units still attack in range and may remove scouts or future participants before the desired launch.
Overwhelming local forces can trigger retreat and remove reporters eligible fighters.
A remembered human HQ/building outranks a nearer visible unit.
Blocked target offsets can be moved by openDestination; the frozen auditor requires the exact clamped planner-target formation offsets, so clear ground around all participant positions is safer.
Exploring more terrain can increase literal snapshot size. No arbitrary fixed unseen coordinate is proposed.

ordinaryUiAlternatives.assessment: Weaker option. Only age upgrades are preinstalled; all players still receive five workers and one fighter. Higher age does not lower the shared readiness threshold/timer and raises balanced AI worker targets13→19/24, enabling additional expansion/research spending.

ordinaryUiAlternatives.choice: Select a smaller normal map setting.
ordinaryUiAlternatives.assessment: Current small is already selected. For four players, small/medium/large all normalize to64×64. Huge expands to88×88. No smaller ordinary four-player map exists. Online source exposes no seed, biome or world-type selector.

ordinaryUiAlternatives.choice: Alter normal resource/income/population handicaps or AI profile.
ordinaryUiAlternatives.assessment: Handicaps are genuine UI settings but are a larger setup change and do not reduce unit training durations; resources can divert spending into workers, research or expansion. Difficulty/personality/opening have no normal online setting; online player allowlist omits ai, config creation supplies no override and defaults are normal/balanced/infantry-rush. No shortcut through private settings is proposed.

finalQualification: Static source supports the contract-preserving candidate-generation change and identifies ordinary UI fallbacks. It cannot prove a future capture, shared-wave identity, byte deadline or feature qualification. No implementation or run is authorized by this report.
